sql: select 'strategy_status' as k, id::text as a, status as b, agent_uuid as c from evo_strategies where id in (49,50,46,36,30,32,33,24,35,38,39,41,43,44,45) union all select 'agent_status', agent_code, status, retired_at::text from evo_agents where agent_code ilike 'EKS-G1-004%' or agent_uuid ilike 'EKS-G1-004%' union all select 'recent_paper_trades_by_strategy', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where strategy is not null and created_at > now() - interval '3 days' group by strategy order by 1
